instruction: Tulis klien HTTP bash tulen tanpa curl
output:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
exec 3<>/dev/tcp/api.example.com/80
printf 'GET /health HTTP/1.0\r\nHost: api.example.com\r\n\r\n' >&3
while IFS= read -r line <&3; do echo "$line"; done
exec 3<&-
```
`/dev/tcp` pseudo-fail bash bercakap TCP mentah — skrip penyelamat dan kontena minima tanpa dependency. HTTPS perlukan `openssl s_client` sebagai pembalut TLS.

instruction: Tulis setup network namespace dan veth manual
output:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
ip netns add red
ip link add v1 type veth peer name v2
ip link set v2 netns red
ip addr add 10.0.0.1/24 dev v1
ip netns exec red ip addr add 10.0.0.2/24 dev v2
ip link set v1 up
ip netns exec red ip link set v2 up
ip netns exec red ping -c2 10.0.0.1
```
Rangkaian terasing buatan tangan: namespace + veth + alamat. Kontena didemistifikasi — tiada sihir, hanya primitif ini.

instruction: Tulis backup borg dengan polisi dalam bash
output:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export BORG_REPO=/backup/borg
export BORG_PASSPHRASE_FILE=/root/.borg-pass
borg create --stats ::"$(date +%F)" /data /etc
borg prune --keep-daily=7 --keep-weekly=4 --keep-monthly=6
borg check --progress
```
Dedupe + sulit + versi dalam satu alat. `borg mount` semak arkib sebelum restore sebenar. Frasa laluan luar skrip (fail 600).

instruction: Tulis setup LUKS disk baharu selamat
output:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
DEV=${1:?contoh: /dev/sdb1}
read -rsp "Taip YES untuk padam $DEV: " c && [[ $c == YES ]]
cryptsetup luksFormat --type luks2 "$DEV"
cryptsetup open "$DEV" data
mkfs.ext4 -L data /dev/mapper/data
cryptsetup close data
echo siap
```
Taip-YES penghadang (bukan `-y` buta), luks2 lalai moden. Header terpisah (`--header`) + keyfile untuk reka pulih.

instruction: Tulis triaj coredump automatik dengan gdb
output:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
core=$(coredumpctl -q list --no-legend | tail -1 | awk '{print $5}')
[[ -n "$core" ]] || { echo "tiada core"; exit 0; }
coredumpctl debug "$core" --batch \
  -ex 'thread apply all bt' -ex 'info registers' 2>&1 | head -40
```
Ambil core terkini, backtrace semua thread + register secara batch. `ulimit -c unlimited` + `kernel.core_pattern` mesti benar dahulu.

instruction: Tulis sim shaping tc untuk ujian WAN
output:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
DEV=${1:-eth0}
tc qdisc add dev "$DEV" root netem delay 100ms 20ms loss 5%
echo "sim aktif pada $DEV (buang: tc qdisc del dev $DEV root)"
```
Uji aplikasi lawan rangkaian pelanggan sebenar dalam makmal: 100ms + jitter + 5% loss. Catat arahan buang — sim terlupa rosakkan hujung minggu.

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
umask 077
wg genkey | tee /etc/wg/priv | wg pubkey > /etc/wg/pub
cat > /etc/wg/wg0.conf <<EOF
[Interface]
Address = 10.9.0.1/24
PrivateKey = $(cat /etc/wg/priv)
ListenPort = 51820
[Peer]
PublicKey = PEER_PUB_GANTI
AllowedIPs = 10.9.0.2/32
EOF
wg-quick up wg0; wg show
```
VPN 4-baris: kunci, antara muka, peer. `wg show` jabat tangan sahkan hidup; PersistentKeepalive tebuk NAT.

instruction: How do I sandbox an untrusted binary with bwrap?
output:
```bash
bwrap --ro-bind /usr /usr --ro-bind /lib /lib \
  --tmpfs /tmp --proc /proc --dev /dev \
  --unshare-all --share-net \
  --seccomp 20 app --flag
```
User-namespace sandbox per invocation: read-only system, fresh /tmp, no host IPC. `--seccomp FD` layers syscall filtering. Scriptable isolation without daemons or images.

instruction: Tulis unit systemd dengan sandboxing penuh
output:
```ini
[Service]
User=app
ExecStart=/srv/app/bin/server
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
LoadCredential=db.pass:/run/secrets/db.pass
Restart=on-failure
```
Daemon terkurung deklaratif: sistem baca-sahaja, tiada eskalasi, rahsia sebagai fail (ghaib dari ps/env). `systemd-analyze security` skor hasilnya.

instruction: Tulis polisi restic dengan semakan dalam bash
output:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export RESTIC_REPOSITORY=s3:s3.example.com/bak
export RESTIC_PASSWORD_FILE=/root/.restic-pass
restic backup /data /etc
restic forget --keep-last 10 --keep-daily 7 --prune
restic check --read-data-subset=10%
```
Sandaran + polisi + scrubbing dalam satu skrip cron. Subset check 10% setiap larian meliputi penuh 10 hari tanpa beban penuh.

instruction: Tulis putaran snapshot btrfs dalam bash
output:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
S=/snap/$(date +%F)
btrfs sub snap -r /data "$S"
ls -dt /snap/* | tail -n +8 | xargs -r -n1 btrfs sub del
btrfs filesystem df /data
```
Snapshot baca-sahaja segera, simpan 7 terkini, pantau ruang (snapshot + quota mendedah hog). `btrfs send` hantar inkremental ke luar tapak.

instruction: How do I watch k8s rollouts from bash?
Tulis flamegraph pantas untuk proses CPU
output:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
PID=${1:?pid required}
perf record -F 99 -p "$PID" -g -- sleep 20
perf script | ./stackcollapse-perf.pl | ./flamegraph.pl > cpu.svg
echo cpu.svg sedia
```
Sampel 99Hz 20 saat, runtuh tindanan, render SVG. Bukti sebelum optimum — bahagian lebar adalah musuh, bukan syak.

instruction: Tulis jejak fail proses dengan opensnoop
output:
```bash
opensnoop-bpfcc -p "$(pgrep -f 'app --serve' | head -1)" 2>&1 | tee opensnoop.log &
SNOOP=$!
sleep 30; kill -INT $SNOOP
awk '{print $NF}' opensnoop.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr | head
```
Setiap open() dengan PID/fail secara live — misteri akses fail selesai tanpa teka. Ranking laluan dedah kebergantungan tersembunyi.

instruction: Tulis semakan DNS semua rekod penting domain
output:
```bash
for t in A AAAA MX TXT NS SOA CAA; do
  echo "== $t =="
  dig +short "$1" "$t" || echo GAGAL
 done
for h in mail "$1"; do dig +short "$h" MX; done
```
Sapu penuh sebelum migrasi DNS: A/AAAA, mel (MX/TXT-SPF), kuasa (NS/SOA), CAA. Bezakan tiada-rekod (kosong) dari ralat resolver.
